footer.aboutText: <name>Chiz.Pink</name> is a daily companion app for Neverness to Everness (NTE). Plan your Esper and arc ascensions, track your pulls and pity on every banner, check off your dailies and weeklies, and keep count of your materials. Everything is saved in your browser locally without an account.
footer.disclaimer: <about>CHIZ.PINK</about> is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with <studio>HOTTA STUDIO™</studio>

ntewiz.title: Migrate from NTEWiz
ntewiz.subtitle: Even though www.ntewiz.xyz is down, your browser still holds your saved characters, arcs, inventory, stamina, and pull history. Transfer everything directly here without downloading a file.
ntewiz.sameBrowserNote: Use the same browser and profile where you previously used NTEWiz.

popup.error: Couldn't receive data from NTEWiz automatically. You can try again or paste the data manually below.

bookmarklet.title: Option 1: Bookmarklet (No File)
bookmarklet.description: Save the button below as a bookmark, then run it while on www.ntewiz.xyz to send your saved data straight to Chiz.Pink.
bookmarklet.dragHint: Don't click it here. Save it as a bookmark first (drag it to your bookmarks bar, right-click -> Bookmark Link, or tap Copy URL on mobile), then run it on www.ntewiz.xyz.

desktop.step1: Drag Migrate NTEWiz to Chiz.Pink onto your bookmarks bar, or right-click it and choose Bookmark Link.
desktop.step2: Open <link>www.ntewiz.xyz</link>. Even though it shows a disabled page, your browser still holds your saved data there.
desktop.step3: Click your new bookmark on that page, then click Send to Chiz.Pink (or use Download JSON / Copy Data).

mobile.step2: Bookmark any page, edit that bookmark, give it a short name like migrate, and replace its URL with the copied link.
mobile.step4: Tap the address bar, type migrate, and tap the starred bookmark suggestion. Then tap Send to Chiz.Pink (or Download JSON and upload it below).
mobile.chromeNote: On Chrome Mobile, don't tap the bookmark from the Bookmarks menu. Launching it from the address bar dropdown is required so it runs on the NTEWiz tab.

console.title: Option 2: Browser Console (Desktop)
console.description: Prefer not to add a bookmark? Run this one-line script in DevTools while on www.ntewiz.xyz. It puts a "Send to Chiz.Pink" button right on the page.
console.step2: Press F12 (or Ctrl+Shift+I / Cmd+Option+I), open the Console tab, paste the script, and press Enter (in Chrome/Edge, type allow pasting first if prompted).
console.step3: Click Send to Chiz.Pink on the page (or Download JSON / Copy Data if popups are blocked).

manual.title: Option 3: Paste Data or Upload Backup File
manual.description: Paste JSON copied from "Copy Data" above, or upload a downloaded ntewiz-export.json / ntewiz-backup-*.json file.
